modules.module_title: Set up and operate 5G-enabled drone data collection tools

pcs.pc_description: identify the appropriate payload sensors (e.g., camera, thermal, LiDAR) based on the mission objective and ensure proper physical and digital integration with the drone.
mount and calibrate data collection sensors according to standard manufacturer and organisational procedures.
connect and configure the 5G communication module (e.g., CPE, 5G modem) for real-time transmission from the drone to the ground station.
verify SIM credentials, network permissions, and 5G signal strength before take-off using diagnostic apps or interfaces.
perform a pre-flight test to confirm stable real- time data streaming and GPS synchronisation between drone and remote controller/monitoring device.
ensure storage redundancy by enabling onboard SD card or SSD backups in parallel with 5G streaming.

modules.module_title: Transmit and verify drone data integrity

pcs.pc_description: activate data recording and 5G transmission through ground control software or flight app interface.
monitor key telemetry indicators (e.g., signal strength, frame drop rate, latency) on the Ground Control Station (GCS) during data collection.
detect and respond to signs of data transmission loss, interference, or compression errors in real time.
validate that transmitted data (e.g., video feeds, sensor readings) is being received in the correct format (e.g., MP4, CSV, GeoTIFF) at the server or base station.
take corrective action such as repositioning the drone, adjusting antenna orientation, or switching to fallback communication modes when transmission degrades.
log data transmission status and any incidents of data corruption or signal loss in flight records or mission reports.
download and extract flight logs, imagery, and telemetry data from the drone’s onboard storage (e.g., SD card, SSD) after landing.
use basic analysis tools (e.g., QGIS, Mission Planner, Pix4Dcapture, or drone OEM software) to open and inspect the quality and completeness of captured data.
identify relevant features or anomalies in data, such as signal drop areas, object detection, vegetation health variation, or asset damage indicators.
perform time-stamp matching between video, GPS, and telemetry layers to validate consistency and flight integrity.
tag data files using mission ID, location, and sensor type for traceability and structured archiving.
prepare a brief summary report containing observations, flight metadata, data issues, and suggested follow-ups.
share findings and highlight abnormal patterns or errors with the technical supervisor or analysis team, following standard data handover protocols.

modules.module_title: Perform visual inspection and preventive maintenance

pcs.pc_description: inspect the drone frame for visible cracks, structural deformation, or corrosion.
check motor mounts and arms for secure attachment and signs of wear.
examine propellers for nicks, warping, and proper alignment.
clean dust and debris from vents, propellers, and sensor housings using lint-free cloth and compressed air.
inspect wiring for fraying, loose connections, and damage.
test motors using onboard diagnostic tools to detect abnormal vibrations or RPM mismatch.
verify sensor alignment and perform basic calibration of IMU, compass, and gimbal.
replace worn-out or damaged components (e.g., propellers, landing gear, vibration dampeners) using standard tools.
check drone battery for swelling, leakage, or charging irregularities.
apply firmware updates for both drone and payload modules using approved OTA or USB interfaces.

modules.module_title: Assist in the deployment and calibration of 5G- Enabled drones

pcs.pc_description: connect and configure the 5G communication module prior to take-off.
validate GPS lock, compass health, and satellite count before mission launch.
conduct health diagnostics of flight controllers, sensors, and communication modules through ground control software.
monitor real-time system readiness indicators, including RC signal strength, video feed status, and battery voltage.
ensure compatible payloads are mounted and properly powered before launch.
report recurring calibration errors, firmware glitches, or initialisation failures to the supervisor.
assist in setting up virtual Geofencing and flight boundary restrictions based on operational requirements.
prepare drones for launch by verifying take- off zone is clear of obstructions and EMI sources.
perform a return-to-home (RTH) test and validate the emergency stop function pre-flight.

modules.module_title: Ensure safe operations and compliance protocols

pcs.pc_description: check daily weather reports and wind speed limits for safe drone operation.
validate drone airframe and batteries meet required safety thresholds as per SOP.
ensure drone is flown only within permitted airspace zones and geo-fence boundaries.
record pre-flight and post-flight checks in drone logbook accurately.
store batteries in fireproof containers and charge them only using certified charging stations.
ensure drone takes off and lands only from designated take-off and landing pads.
wear appropriate PPE (e.g., gloves, goggles) while handling drone hardware and batteries.
report safety non-compliance, incidents, or near-misses to the designated authority.
follow all organisational SOPs related to take-off, landing, emergency procedures, and no- fly conditions.
